metadata.question: Was the nightime brightness in San Juan lower on September 27-28, 2017 than September 1-2, 2017?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: VIIRS nighttime lights (NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG or VIIRS/DNB/DAILY) - Dates: September 1-2, 2017 vs September 27-28, 2017 - Location: San Juan, Puerto Rico (around -66.1, 18.47) - Note: Hurricane Maria hit Puerto Rico on Sept 20, 2017, so expect dramatic decrease 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for nighttime lights - Use the avg_rad_band (average radiance) from VIIRS DNB 3. Logic: - Valid Zero (A): If brightness decreased (Sept 27-28 < Sept 1-2), answer A - Valid measurement but not decreased (B): If brightness same or higher - C1: If no images found for either period - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels - C3: If calculation returns None/NaN ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define San Juan, Puerto Rico location const sanJuan = ee.Geometry.Point([-66.1057, 18.4655]); const region = sanJuan.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around city center // Define date ranges const date1Start = '2017-09-01'; const date1End = '2017-09-03'; const date2Start = '2017-09-27'; const date2End = '2017-09-29'; try { // Try VIIRS DNB Monthly product first let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2017-09-01', '2017-09-02'); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2017-09-01', '2017-10-01'); const size1 = await col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Monthly collection Sept 1: ${size1} images`); console.log(`Monthly collection Sept (full): ${size2} images`); // Monthly data likely won't have daily resolution, use composite for the month if (size2 === 0) { console.log("No VIIRS monthly data available"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get September 2017 composite and sample at two dates const sept2017 = col2.first().select('avg_rad'); // Calculate mean brightness for early September (using monthly composite) const stats1 = await sept2017.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); // For post-hurricane, we need to check if there's significant change // Since monthly data aggregates the whole month, let's use a different approach // Check MOD13A2 or use annual comparison // Actually, let's use VIIRS annual composites or check the monthly value const earlyCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2017-08-01', '2017-09-20'); // Pre-hurricane const lateCol = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMSLCFG') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate('2017-09-20', '2017-10-15'); // Post-hurricane const earlySize = await earlyCol.size().getInfo(); const lateSize = await lateCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Pre-hurricane images: ${earlySize}`); console.log(`Post-hurricane images: ${lateSize}`); if (earlySize === 0 || lateSize === 0) { console.log("Insufficient temporal coverage"); console.log("C1"); return; } const earlyImg = earlyCol.mean().select('avg_rad'); const lateImg = lateCol.mean().select('avg_rad'); const earlyStats = await earlyImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const lateStats = await lateImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const earlyBrightness = earlyStats.avg_rad; const lateBrightness = lateStats.avg_rad; console.log(`Early Sept brightness: ${earlyBrightness !== null ? earlyBrightness.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); console.log(`Late Sept brightness: ${lateBrightness !== null ? lateBrightness.toFixed(2) : 'null'}`); if (earlyBrightness === null || lateBrightness === null || isNaN(earlyBrightness) || isNaN(lateBrightness)) { console.log("Invalid brightness values"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (lateBrightness < earlyBrightness) { console.log(`Brightness decreased: ${lateBrightness.toFixed(2)} < ${earlyBrightness.toFixed(2)}`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Brightness not lower: ${lateBrightness.toFixed(2)} >= ${earlyBrightness.toFixed(2)}`); console.log("B"); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
